activity.notes: After returning to England in 1689, Locke published the major works that established his mature philosophical and political legacy across 1689-1690. ATLAS uses this publication phase as a conservative representative intellectual Activity rather than his entire life.

sources.title: John Locke — Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
sources.citation_text: The Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy documents Locke's return to England in 1689 and the publication of his major mature works in 1689-1690.
